title: Careers — Supreme Art
description: Build your career in print at Supreme Art — a hands-on pharmaceutical carton factory in Pakistan that values craft and precision.

intro.heading: Build your career in print.
paragraphs: We're a hands-on factory that values craft and precision. Our team keeps pharma brands supplied with packaging they can trust — and we're always glad to hear from people who take pride in getting the details right.
If that sounds like you, send us your CV and tell us what you do best.

roles.heading: Where you could fit in.

items.title: Designer
items.text: Shape artwork, dielines and proofs for pharmaceutical cartons, labels and leaflets, from the first sketch to the approved file.

items.title: Machine Operator
items.text: Run and care for our Heidelberg presses and finishing machines, holding colour, register and quality through every run.

items.title: Accountant
items.text: Keep our books, invoices and payments in order, and help the business plan with clear, accurate numbers.

items.title: HR & Admin
items.text: Look after our people and the office: hiring, records, attendance and the everyday running of the factory.

items.title: Driver
items.text: Carry finished cartons safely to our clients across Pakistan, on time and with care.

roles.footnote_before: Don't see your role? We still want to hear from good people —

cta.heading: Ready to join us?
cta.text: Send your CV and a short note about what you'd like to do.
